objective: Two independent receipt-timed capital and reservation books; exact native NATIVE_MAX risk/notional/cash sizing and unchanged reservation engine, no forced matched trade identities or quantities.
structural_hypothesis: When exit receipts and known cash differ, the two books' admissible integer quantities and even funded campaign identities can diverge under exactly the same signals; fixed native entries are not a universal stochastic coupling.
refutation_criteria: Any signal quantity uses price bars with availableAt > decisionAt or outcome receipts with knownAt > decisionAt
Either book consumes the other's closed proceeds, quantities, receipts, or reservation book
Any terminal cash reconciliation mismatch beyond USD 0.00005
Any 12 percent cap asserted as continuous or an OHLC threshold asserted as observed fill
Any horizon > 72h, unexplained partial close, negative quantity, unresolved reservation, or stale pending IOC released early
Any native planner/risk/notional/cash gate replaced by an invented looser formula
finite_fixture_catalog: delayed terminal receipt exclusion from earlier purchasing power
terminal exposure and missing execution fail closed
excluded: No new trading signals or new candidate variants; no synthetic economic market accounts; no final paths; no broker; no claim of realized edge or stochastic impossibility.
controls: M10 previous best QUALITY_NATIVE_QUEUE72_R0625 stays registered without rerun
scope_limits: Receipt factory is an engineering evidence adapter; absent a complete data-backed two-book native replay, matching the full native campaign distribution is not certified.
Decision-clock drawdown is only an observed subset; worst-session, universal event risk and outage/partial/reject/impact coverage are not certified.
Exact original sizing and reservation functions called; independent equity mark convention may require further parity checks with native replay.
Off-grid OHLC receipts remain hypothetical and never treated as real executions.
